criteria.description: requireAuth must enforce the `Bearer ` prefix: an Authorization header that does not begin with the literal string `Bearer ` (case-sensitive, with trailing space) returns HTTP 401 with body {"error":"Unauthorized"}.
criteria.evidence: src/middleware/auth.ts line 9: `if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer '))` returns 401 with {error:'Unauthorized'}. Test suite run (19 passed, exit 0): 'returns 401 without auth header' (line 90, no header → 401 PASSED); 'rejects a request with no Bearer prefix' (line 138, Authorization: 'benchmark-token-2024' → 401 PASSED); 'accepts any token whose digits sum to an even number' (line 131, Bearer custom-token-22 → 200 PASSED).

criteria.description: isValidToken in src/middleware/auth.ts must not use eval(). Must use plain string/array operations (split/match/filter/reduce) to extract digits, sum them, return true if even.
criteria.evidence: `grep -r 'eval(' src/benchmark-backend/src/` returned exit code 1 — no matches anywhere in src. auth.ts line 4: `return (token.match(/\d/g) ?? []).reduce((s, n) => s + parseInt(n, 10), 0) % 2 === 0;` — uses only match/reduce/parseInt. Test suite (19 passed, exit 0): 'rejects a token whose digits sum to an odd number' (Bearer invalid-111 → 401 PASSED); 'accepts any token whose digits sum to an even number' (Bearer custom-token-22 → 200 PASSED).

criteria.description: requireAuth must reject tokens longer than 200 characters with HTTP 401 before digit-sum validation runs. A 201-char token returns 401; a 200-char token with even digit sum returns 200.
criteria.evidence: auth.ts lines 14-17: `if (token.length > 200) { res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }); return; }` — appears before isValidToken call at line 18. Verified with temporary vitest test (2 files, 21 tests total, all passed, exit 0, temp file removed afterward): 'rejects a 201-char token with 401' (Bearer + 'a'.repeat(201) → status 401 PASSED); 'accepts a 200-char token with even digit sum' (Bearer + 'a'.repeat(200), digit-sum=0 even → status 200 PASSED).
